All other recent news items are routine stock-movement, analyst commentary, or earnings pieces scored at severity 0, and the one other elevated item (supply_disruption, SEC 8-K) is explicitly described as contained within full-year guidance. Given the low payment delinquency and the unconfirmed nature of the key negative headline, the Healthy band is reasonable, but the underwriter should note the news score's reliance on an uncorroborated, detail-free headline and should watch whether the 9-day overdue invoice resolves or ages further.
